description: Crossfades between two stereo pairs on an equal-power law whose curve can be bent

params.text: Fades from the A pair at 0% through both at equal power in the centre to the B pair at 100%
Bends the fade curve from straight at 0% to logarithmic at 100%, which moves the level less at the ends of the travel and faster near the centre

inputs.text: Moves the fade; the knob is read as a voltage between -5V and +5V, this jack is added to it, and the total is clamped to that range
Left channel of the A pair
Right channel of the A pair; with this jack empty the A left signal is used for both
Left channel of the B pair
Right channel of the B pair; with this jack empty the B left signal is used for both

outputs.text: The left channels of the two pairs faded together
The right channels of the two pairs faded together

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the A left input.
inputs.4:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the B left input.
